mountain_pose.name: Mountain Pose
mountain_pose.description: Foundational standing pose for grounding and alignment
mountain_pose.instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, arms at sides. Distribute weight evenly, engage core, lengthen spine.
mountain_pose.modifications: Use wall support for balance, place block between thighs to engage legs.

upward_salute.name: Upward Salute
upward_salute.description: Standing pose with arms raised overhead
upward_salute.instructions: From Mountain Pose, sweep arms overhead, palms facing each other or touching.
upward_salute.modifications: Keep hands on hips if shoulders are tight, bend elbows slightly.

forward_fold.name: Forward Fold
forward_fold.instructions: Hinge at hips, fold forward with straight spine. Let arms hang or rest on legs.
forward_fold.modifications: Bend knees generously, use blocks under hands, hold opposite elbows.

halfway_lift.name: Halfway Lift
halfway_lift.description: Partial forward fold with flat back
halfway_lift.instructions: From forward fold, place hands on shins or fingertips to floor, flatten back.
halfway_lift.modifications: Hands to thighs or blocks, focus on long spine over depth.

low_push_up.name: Low Push-Up
low_push_up.instructions: From plank, lower down keeping elbows close to body, hover above ground.
low_push_up.modifications: Drop knees to ground, use blocks under chest, skip and go to child's pose.

upward_dog.name: Upward Dog
upward_dog.description: Backbend with arms supporting body weight
upward_dog.instructions: Press hands down, lift chest and thighs off ground, open heart forward.
upward_dog.modifications: Keep thighs on ground (cobra variation), use blocks under hands.

downward_dog.name: Downward Dog
downward_dog.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, feet hip-width apart, lift hips up and back.
downward_dog.modifications: Bend knees, pedal feet, use blocks under hands, forearms down.

warrior_i.name: Warrior I
warrior_i.instructions: Step one foot back, bend front knee over ankle, square hips forward, arms up.
warrior_i.modifications: Narrow stance for balance, hands on hips, use wall support.

warrior_ii.name: Warrior II
warrior_ii.description: Standing lunge with arms parallel to ground
warrior_ii.instructions: Wide-legged stance, bend one knee, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front hand.
warrior_ii.modifications: Shorter stance, hand on front thigh, use wall behind back leg.

side_angle.name: Side Angle
side_angle.instructions: From Warrior II, place front hand on thigh or floor, reach top arm over ear.
side_angle.modifications: Hand stays on thigh, use block under bottom hand, take bind under front thigh.

vinyasa_flow.name: Vinyasa Flow
vinyasa_flow.instructions: Flow through plank, low push-up, upward dog, downward dog.
vinyasa_flow.modifications: Skip challenging poses, step back/forward instead of jumping.

easy_pose.name: Easy Pose
easy_pose.instructions: Sit cross-legged, hands on knees or in lap, spine tall.
easy_pose.modifications: Sit on block or blanket, lean against wall, extend legs if uncomfortable.

gentle_neck_rolls.name: Gentle Neck Rolls
gentle_neck_rolls.description: Slow circular movements to warm neck
gentle_neck_rolls.instructions: Slowly roll head in semicircles, avoid full circles, move mindfully.
gentle_neck_rolls.modifications: Just turn head side to side, support head with hand.

seated_cat_cow.name: Seated Cat-Cow
seated_cat_cow.instructions: Arch and round spine while seated, coordinate with breath.
seated_cat_cow.modifications: Smaller movements, hand support on knees.

seated_twist.name: Seated Twist
seated_twist.instructions: Sit tall, place one hand behind hip, other on opposite knee, twist gently.
seated_twist.modifications: Use chair back for support, smaller range of motion.

forward_fold_seated.name: Forward Fold Seated
forward_fold_seated.instructions: Hinge at hips, fold forward over legs, keep spine long.
forward_fold_seated.modifications: Bend knees, use strap around feet, place pillow on legs.

childs_pose.name: Child's Pose
childs_pose.instructions: Kneel, sit back on heels, fold forward, arms extended or at sides.
childs_pose.modifications: Place pillow between calves and thighs, widen knees, use bolster.

table_top.name: Table Top
table_top.instructions: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, neutral spine.
table_top.modifications: Place blanket under knees, use blocks under hands if wrists hurt.

cat_cow_stretches.name: Cat-Cow Stretches
cat_cow_stretches.description: Spinal mobility on hands and knees
cat_cow_stretches.instructions: Alternate between arching (cow) and rounding (cat) the spine.
cat_cow_stretches.modifications: Smaller movements, move slowly, support knees with blanket.

low_lunge.name: Low Lunge
low_lunge.instructions: Step one foot forward, lower back knee, hands on front thigh or floor.
low_lunge.modifications: Place blanket under back knee, use blocks under hands.

lizard_pose.name: Lizard Pose
lizard_pose.description: Deep hip opener from low lunge
lizard_pose.instructions: From low lunge, place both hands inside front foot, lower to forearms if possible.
lizard_pose.modifications: Stay on hands, use blocks under forearms, keep back knee down.

half_pigeon.name: Half Pigeon
half_pigeon.description: Deep hip opener with front leg bent
half_pigeon.instructions: Front knee bent, back leg straight, sit upright or fold forward.
half_pigeon.modifications: Place block or pillow under front hip, stay upright, use wall support.

low_cobra.name: Low Cobra
low_cobra.instructions: Lie on belly, hands under shoulders, lift chest using back muscles.
low_cobra.modifications: Keep forearms down, very small lift, place pillow under hips.

cobra_pose.name: Cobra Pose
cobra_pose.instructions: Press hands down, straighten arms, lift chest, keep hips grounded.
cobra_pose.modifications: Stay on forearms, press hands lightly, use block between thighs.

camel_pose_prep.name: Camel Pose Prep
camel_pose_prep.instructions: Kneel, hands on lower back, lean back gently, open chest.
camel_pose_prep.modifications: Hands stay on hips, use wall behind back, place block between thighs.

supine_spinal_twist.name: Supine Spinal Twist
supine_spinal_twist.instructions: Lie on back, draw knees to chest, drop both knees to one side.
supine_spinal_twist.modifications: Place pillow between legs, support knees with bolster.

seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold
seated_forward_fold.description: Forward bend from seated position with legs extended
seated_forward_fold.instructions: Sit with legs extended, hinge at hips, fold forward over legs.
seated_forward_fold.modifications: Bend knees, use strap around feet, sit on blanket.

supine_knee_to_chest.name: Supine Knee to Chest
supine_knee_to_chest.description: Gentle hip release lying on back
supine_knee_to_chest.instructions: Lie on back, hug knees to chest, rock side to side if desired.
supine_knee_to_chest.modifications: Keep one foot on ground, use strap around thighs.

happy_baby_pose.name: Happy Baby Pose
happy_baby_pose.description: Playful hip opener lying on back
happy_baby_pose.instructions: Lie on back, grab outside edges of feet, knees toward armpits.
happy_baby_pose.modifications: Hold behind thighs instead, use strap around feet, rock side to side.

knees_to_chest.name: Knees to Chest
knees_to_chest.instructions: Lie on back, hug both knees into chest, breathe deeply.
knees_to_chest.modifications: Keep head on ground, place pillow behind head.

savasana.name: Savasana
savasana.instructions: Lie on back, arms and legs relaxed, close eyes, focus on breath.
savasana.modifications: Place pillow under knees, blanket over body, bolster under knees.
